rules.action: the author MUST keep imports within core

enforcement.check: core imports only its own files, including nested files and every module form

rules.rationale: Core stays independent of replaceable adapters.

rules.trigger: the CLI receives an unknown command
rules.action: the CLI MUST fail with exit 64 and a message naming the command, and MUST NOT forward it to any other binary

enforcement.check: unknown and retired commands exit 64 with a clear stderr message and print nothing to stdout

rules.rationale: A removed command fails loudly instead of showing a stale legacy help screen with exit 0; no legacy install remains to forward to.

rules.trigger: a change is ready for integration
rules.action: the author MUST obtain a successful full Product aggregate `Check` from GitHub Actions (App `15368`) on the exact HEAD
rules.rationale: Full required CI is the only gate: lint, typecheck and touched tests run locally, then auto-merge on the Check; review, red-first and local gates are opt-in.

rules.trigger: agent state is written for this repository
rules.action: the author MUST keep agent state under `.krn/`

enforcement.check: project tools ignore nested worktree state

rules.rationale: Agent state is repository-local and stays outside tracked project inputs.

rules.trigger: the lead works in this repository
rules.action: the lead MUST follow `docs/program/lead-rules.md` for evidence, proposals, handoffs, and delivery
rules.rationale: Lead methods have one durable owner.

rules.trigger: an agent works in this repository
rules.action: the agent MUST follow `docs/program/repository-workflow.md` for the local KRN delivery process and terminal PR closeout
rules.rationale: KRN process belongs only in repositories that explicitly adopt it; the global contract stays universal and minimal.

rules.action: the lead MUST manage task status in `tasks/<id>.json` with `krn task` (`ready`, `claim`, `release`, `close`); workers MUST NOT mutate tracker state, must receive the task id in their brief, and MUST use it in commit titles and the `Ticket:` trailer
rules.rationale: Work status travels with the repository and delivery remains traceable to its task.

rules.action: the author MUST test every integration or forward against its real receiver or a verbatim capture of its output
rules.rationale: Receiver-boundary evidence verifies integration and forwarding contracts.

rules.trigger: the lead works in this repository
rules.action: the lead MUST keep context bounded: delegate reading to a subagent returning a verdict and path, pass pointers instead of file contents, verify by commands that print a verdict, run independent slices as parallel worktree lanes with background agents, and hand off at the context-gauge advisory with `krn-handoff`
rules.rationale: Fresh sessions restart from durable files instead of accumulating context.
